name: Méthodes et Outils pour la Conception en Agroforesterie
lead: GRAB (Groupe de Recherche en Agriculture Biologique)
description:
The MOCA project aimed to develop practical methods and tools to support the design and ex-ante assessment of agroforestry systems, helping farmers, advisors and educators create economically viable, environmentally sustainable and socially desirable systems.

Through a participatory approach involving farmers, researchers, technical advisors and educational institutions, the project addressed the complexity of agroforestry system design, including spatial arrangements, tree-crop interactions, temporal development and the environmental, economic and social performance of proposed systems.

The project developed and consolidated three complementary decision-support tools: DEXiAF, for the multicriteria assessment of agroforestry system sustainability; EcoAF, for 3D spatial design and simulation of tree growth and shading effects; and DiAFnostic, for predicting the development and timber production potential of trees in young agroforestry plantations.
